Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Set expiration date for a lab announcement

Body.Content:
As a lab admin, you can now set an expiration date and time for a lab announcement. That is, you can post an announcement for a specified period without having to disable it manually. The announcement will stop appearing on the overview page of the lab after the expiration date and time.

To know more about this feature, go to our team blog.
